summary: GSK plc filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing Director/PDMR shareholding notifications under UK MAR. Four executives—Lynn Baxter (CEO ViiV Healthcare/Global Health), CFO Julie Brown, David Redfern (Corporate Development), and Regis Simard (Global Supply Chain)—each acquired 12 ordinary shares of 31p at £19.3453 on 2026-11-10 on the London Stock Exchange, split 6 partnership and 6 matching shares under the Company's Share Reward Plan. No special-situation event, terms, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are present; this is an ordinary insider-dealing disclosure with no risk-arb angle.
